change: Auto-pause when no job runs and outside 08-18 on working days; automatic start before each quarterly training window
risks_and_exceptions: T-1053: quarterly training on days 1-3 of Jan, Apr, Jul, Oct needs the cluster continuously, so the schedule starts it automatically beforehand. Needs human decision: Head of IT.

description: Cancel unused AI seats, per department
change: Reduce seats to active users plus a buffer at the next monthly notice date, by cost centre
risks_and_exceptions: T-1128: seats are ordered per department, so the cut is per cost centre. 30-day notice, monthly billing. 80 % of the unused value to keep a buffer. No energy saving claimed: idle seats send no messages. Needs human decision: each department head.

description: Cancel unused SaaS seats at each contract's notice date
change: Reduce paid seats to active users plus a buffer, contract by contract, at the next notice date
risks_and_exceptions: Per contract (measures/m8_contracts.csv): notice given 1 Dec 2026; monthly-billed contracts save from 1 Dec + notice period, annual ones from the first contract end whose notice date is still open, otherwise one year later (CRM platform and Survey tool are locked until 2028). Counted: 90 % of the unused seat value (10 % buffer) for the months inside Dec 2026 - Nov 2027; the full run-rate is higher once every contract has renewed. No energy claimed (no factor for SaaS). Needs human decision: contract owners.
assumptions_and_sources: Per contract from out/fact_costs.csv saas rows: unused = (seats bought - active) / bought x cost; saving = 90 % of unused x share of Dec 2026 - Nov 2027 after the notice date (measures/m8_contracts.csv). Run-rate once all renewed: CHF 38,920 a year. ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026. Market-based CO2 stays blank: measures/measures.csv has no market-based kilogram, and the pipeline baseline is location-based.

description: Route simple office-assistant tasks to a small model
change: Summarise, Translate and simple questions go to a small model; complex tasks stay on the large one
risks_and_exceptions: Share of tasks that can move is an assumption (50 %). Needs human decision: quality check per task type.
assumptions_and_sources: ASSUMPTION 50 % of large-model use (Summarise, Translate, simple questions) can move; CHF = large-model cost x 50 % x (1 - small/large price per token 0.28, from ai-assistant rows); energy = token-weighted saving share (input and output tokens). ASSUMPTIONS: realisation share and person-days. Sources: out/fact_costs.csv, out/findings.csv, factors/factors.csv; Sample data ALTYCA, sprintd Basel 2026.
